rules.description: The main text is at most nine content pages, including all figures and tables; references, the checklist and the technical appendices do not count. Source: https://neurips.cc/Conferences/2025/CallForPapers
Body text uses 10 point type with 11 point leading. Source: https://media.neurips.cc/Conferences/NeurIPS2025/Styles.zip (neurips_2025.tex)
Pages are US Letter, not A4. Source: https://media.neurips.cc/Conferences/NeurIPS2025/Styles.zip (neurips_2025.tex)

The paper includes the NeurIPS Paper Checklist; papers without it are desk rejected. Source: https://media.neurips.cc/Conferences/NeurIPS2025/Styles.zip (neurips_2025.tex) and https://neurips.cc/Conferences/2025/CallForPapers
Acknowledgments are not included at submission time. Source: https://neurips.cc/Conferences/2025/CallForPapers
Review is double-blind: the submission must not identify its authors. Source: https://neurips.cc/Conferences/2025/CallForPapers
